display_long_description:
Step into VSS - Virtual Sports Soccer, a Football brand-new VR sports competitive experience inspired by traditional football that transforms it into a thrilling realistic simulator.  

Master the physics-based gameplay, challenge rivals in intense 1v1 soccer duels, and climb the global rankings to prove you are the best.

• Realistic Football Physics in VR: Feel every kick, pass, and goal thanks to advanced immersive gameplay mechanics.

• Monthly Skins & Player Customization: Personalize your avatar and stand out with exclusive skins released every month.

• Weekly & Monthly Tournaments: Compete for rewards, prizes, and glory in exciting online competitions.

• World Championships: Take your skills from virtual fields to real-world stages with massive USD prize pools.

• Multiple Game Modes: Train with friends, face smart AI, or battle random opponents from all over the world.

• Ranked Mode & Leaderboards: Earn seasonal rewards and climb to the top of the competitive ladder.

VSS - Virtual Sports Soccer, is a new immersive sports discipline from Football  & soccer, created to bring together competition, community, and the excitement of football in virtual reality.
